Execution order: step 12 of 13. Depends on Adashi task ID 21. Complete this prerequisite before starting.

Phase: shared server SQL adoption.

Extend project storage settings and migration to the server backend:
- Expose engine-specific nonsecret connection settings, project namespace selection and connection validation according to task 20.
- Resolve each user's credentials securely and consistently for desktop and MCP without storing secrets in Git-tracked files, exported projects or logs.
- Support intentional new-project initialization and joining an existing shared project without reseeding, replacing identity or copying local paths into shared canonical data.
- Extend the migration service to SQLite/text to SQL and SQL to SQLite/text, preserving all authoritative data and ID/reference mappings.
- Validate the destination before activation; coordinate concurrent writes and schema compatibility, retain recoverable source data, and reject unsafe migration into an existing populated destination.
- Document connection setup, user provisioning, backups, restore, upgrades and behavior when the server is unavailable.

Acceptance: separate users configure local credentials for the same project and both clients resolve the correct store. Supported conversions and failure recovery preserve data; backend changes are project-specific and never silently fall back to another store.

Markdown design artefact integration (approved 2026-09-25):
Extend the complete-domain conversion work delivered by Markdown 04/12 (task ID 28) to all supported SQL directions. Include Markdown bodies, stable identities, ordered associations, direct bindings, task/QA references and applicable deletion history in transfer inventories, staged counts/fingerprints, backup/restore and rollback/recovery. Test SQLite/text-to-SQL and SQL-to-SQLite/text without silent omissions. Never treat generated Markdown or checkout-local projection manifests as authoritative shared data. After activation, regenerate local outputs from the destination; preserve dirty document-editor drafts and report projection failures separately from successful conversion.

data.title: Storage 12/13 — Add secure SQL connection settings and backend migration
